title: COG (Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF) Provider
description: Raster tiles served via TiTiler from S3-hosted COG files. Best for continuous raster data (elevation, NDVI, climate indices).

body.source: S3 URI of the COG file, e.g. s3://bucket/path/file.tif. Use this OR url.
body.url: Pre-built TiTiler tile URL template including {z}/{x}/{y}. Use this OR source.
body.colormap_name: Named colormap string, e.g. 'viridis', 'plasma', 'rdylgn'. Mutually exclusive with colormap.
body.colormap: Custom colormap. Two formats: (1) gradient object: {'0':[r,g,b,a],'128':[r,g,b,a],'255':[r,g,b,a]} with rescale param, or (2) interval array: [[[lo,hi],[r,g,b,a]],...] without rescale.
body.rescale: Array [min,max] for value-to-color mapping. Required with gradient colormap format.
body.bidx: Band index (1-based integer). E.g. 1 for first band.
body.nodata: Value to treat as transparent, e.g. -9999 or 0.
body.clip_geometry: GeoJSON geometry to clip the tile output.

examples.description: COG with named colormap and source URI

notes: COG files must be accessible from TiTiler — use public S3 objects or pre-signed URLs.
The S3 data bucket is public-read; use s3://bucket/path format for source.
TiTiler automatically handles reprojection and tiling.
For new raster layers, always upload to S3 first and get the s3:// URI.
